conclusions: Source pack is bundled and read at generation time.
Python writer mirrors KiCad S-expression project/schematic structure; it does not execute KiCad C++.
Every generated wire is emitted as a separate two-point object.
Symbols are embedded into the schematic so global library lookup is not required for V1 core output.
All required V1 source reference files are present.

note: This KiCad schematic was generated from final JSON with real embedded symbols and connection objects produced by kicad_wire_maker. In strict wire mode, local labels are forbidden and any unroutable nets are recorded in this manifest.
